tutorial:
[color=#ffffff]-[/color] Welcome to [color=#ff1c18][pulse freq=3.0 color=#ffffff64 ease=-100.0]MY ROLE IN THE GRAND SCHEME[/pulse][/color]!

    [color=#ffffff]-[/color] In the grimy alleys of [color=#ff8864]NEW-CAELUM[/color], you're a former... whatever... turned [color=#ff8864]PRIVATE EYE[/color]. The city you live in is a cesspool of corruption and crime, where every shadow hides a secret. It’s gonna take some serious hustling to dive into cases ranging from petty crimes to scandals involving the city's elite.
    [color=#ffffff]-[/color] To navigate this brutal world, you'll use [color=#ff8864]CARDS[/color] representing various concepts to [color=#ff1c18]INTERROGATE CHARACTERS[/color], [color=#ff1c18]SEARCH LOCATIONS[/color], and gather [color=#ff8864]CLUES[/color] and [color=#ff8864]INFORMATION[/color] (you may even have to [color=#ff1c18]FIGHT[/color] but we wish that you won't have to). These cards are your tools to "[color=#ffffff]talk[/color]" with the "[color=#ffffff]GREAT ONE[/color]" (the game), shaping events and determining your actions. Each card can represent an [color=#ff1c18]ACTION[/color], a [color=#ff1c18]SKILL[/color], an [color=#ff1c18]OBJECT[/color], a [color=#ff1c18]LOCATION[/color], or even a [color=#ff1c18]CHARACTER[/color]... Choose wisely; every decision could mean the difference between [color=#ff8864]LIFE[/color] and [color=#ff8864]DEATH[/color].
    [color=#ffffff]-[/color] [color=#ff8864]THE GAME IS DELIBERATELY TOUGH[/color], mirroring the challenges of a radical life change. Prepare to face criminals and unpredictable situations. Your old job didn't pay much, and neither does this new one. Too late to back out now. You'll need to Manage your [color=#ff1c18]DAILY DRUG HABIT[/color], pay [color=#ff1c18]WEEKLY BILLS[/color], control your [color=#ff1c18]EMOTIONS[/color], avoid [color=#ff1c18]PISSING OFF THE AUTHORITIES[/color], etc. Staying alert is crucial for survival. But don't let it drive you to [color=#ff8864]PARANOIA[/color]!
    [color=#ffffff]-[/color] To [color=#ff8864]ORGANIZE[/color] your [color=#ff8864]FINDINGS[/color], you'll have an [color=#ff1c18]INVESTIGATION BOARD[/color] on the wall. [color=#ff8864]PIN CARDS[/color] representing collected [color=#ff8864]INFORMATION[/color] and [color=#ff8864]CONNECT THEM[/color] with [color=#ff1c18]COLORED STRINGS[/color] based on the [color=#ff1c18]RELATIONSHIPS[/color] you [color=#ff8864]UNCOVER[/color]. Each string symbolizes a link between [color=#ff1c18]CLUES[/color], [color=#ff1c18]CHARACTERS[/color], and [color=#ff1c18]LOCATIONS[/color], helping you [color=#ff8864]DEFINE[/color] a [color=#ff1c18]MOTIVE[/color], [color=#ff8864]IDENTIFY[/color] a [color=#ff1c18]CULPRIT[/color], and [color=#ff8864]PIECE TOGETHER EVENTS[/color].
    [color=#ffffff]-[/color] As you [color=#ff1c18]INTERACT[/color], you'll [color=#ff1c18]KEEP[/color] or [color=#ff1c18]DISCARD[/color] certain [color=#ff8864]CARDS[/color], building your [color=#ff8864]PERSONALIZED DECK[/color] just as you would [color=#ff8864]TRAIN[/color] to [color=#ff8864]IMPROVE YOUR SKILLS[/color]. Each [color=#ff1c18]MASTERED CARD[/color] becomes a [color=#ff1c18]VALUABLE ASSET[/color], helping you navigate the game's challenges. [color=#ff1c18]YOUR CHARACTER WILL EVOLVE[/color] based on your [color=#ff1c18]MAJOR SUCCESSES[/color] or [color=#ff1c18]MONUMENTAL FAILURES[/color], shaping your journey uniquely.
    [color=#ffffff]-[/color] Each case is a new adventure, bringing you closer to the [color=#ff8864]ULTIMATE TRUTH[/color]. But be warned, in this dark world, the truth can be more dangerous than you imagine. Nevertheless, [color=#ff8864]SOLVING A CASE[/color] will give you some [color=#ff8864]FINANCIAL BREATHING ROOM[/color], maybe even a bit more if you are lucky.
    [color=#ffffff]-[/color] [color=#ff8864]New-Caelum[/color] isn't a city for the faint-hearted. Criminals lurk, waiting for the perfect moment to strike. Be ready for anything and use your skills to navigate this world of shadows.
